name: regulated
_comment: Example profile for a team in a regulated domain (traceability, audit trail, acceptance criteria as input to the judgement). Copy it, rename it, and keep everything team-specific here: the core knows no organisation, tracker key or stack. If something your team needs does not fit this format, the core is wrong; open an issue instead of hardcoding.

rules.description: Every behaviour change references the work item's acceptance criterion it satisfies (in the PR body and, where the project convention says so, in the test name).
A change to a persisted business entity keeps who/when/what recoverable: no in-place overwrite of audited fields without the audit record the project convention requires.
A schema migration ships with its rollback, or the PR declares why a rollback is impossible.
Debug output left in production code.

tracker._comment: Replace with your exporter: an executable that receives the item key as last argument and prints JSON. Use adapter "fixture" with "path" to point at an exported JSON file instead.
